name: us023-baseline-no-event
description: 023, Phase 1, T003 (FR-011): a full reconcile with SPEC_KIT_JIRA_HOOK_EVENT UNSET, against a project that DOES declare a phase_status_map. Byte-for-byte identical to a project declaring no mapping at all: zero availability reads, zero transition writes, no counts.transitioned key — a recorded regression baseline for the promise that declaring the mapping alone changes nothing without a dispatched event.

content.text: We need to prove declared mapping moves a recognised story to its agreed step.
As a user, I want the first capability.
**Given** a starting state **When** the user acts **Then** the first outcome happens
